hero.lead: A principality of 38,000 on the Mediterranean, where safe water, sanitation and power reach every home and lower-secondary completion is universal on the World Bank measure.

assets.heading: Three assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 13.8% are under fifteen: the workforce and the market of the next generation.

items.name: The Land
items.label: Land area, 2023
items.text: Two square kilometres between the mountains and the sea.

items.name: The Income
items.label: GDP a person, 2024
items.text: Output a person on a scale that can finance far beyond the nation’s own borders.

coverage.gap_text: Every standard measured for Monaco is met: water, sanitation, power and schooling. Food security and poverty are not measured.

guarantees.name: Food
guarantees.note: No FAO measure of food insecurity is published for Monaco

guarantees.name: Shelter
guarantees.note: Safely managed sanitation; 0% of city dwellers live in slums

guarantees.name: Energy
guarantees.note: 100% cook with clean fuels and technology; 100% have electricity

guarantees.name: Education
guarantees.note: 100% of young people complete lower secondary school

guarantees.name: Livelihoods
guarantees.note: No poverty survey for Monaco is published by the World Bank
